# DEC-0001: Buy the drip irrigation kit from supplier A

Back to the [decision log](../decision-log.md).

## Decision

Buy the drip irrigation kit from supplier A; supplier B is rejected for this season.

## Context

Choosing a supplier for the drip irrigation kit.

## Rationale

Supplier A guarantees delivery before the April planting; supplier B could not commit to a delivery date.

## Alternatives considered

- Buy the kit from supplier B

## Decided by

Steering group

## Decided on

2026-03-12

## Impacts

The irrigation can be installed before the April planting.

## Sources

> the group agreed to buy the drip irrigation kit from supplier A, because they guarantee delivery before the April planting.

From [ART-0001](../../artifacts/ART-0001-steering-group.md), 2026-03-12.
